text:
Asking rents in Munster stand at a median of 13.92 €/m² (2026-06), up 5.4% on the year and +30.9% over five years. That ranks Munster #11 of 37 cities; new lets are priced 60% above the 2022 average contract rent of 8.71 €/m².

A 60 m² flat costs about 835 € a month in cold rent, 17.2% of the disposable income of two residents. Listings stay online for about 21 days and 36% are gone within a week; with 1.1% market-active vacancy and +2.5% population growth over five years, the market looks tight.

The model estimate for twelve months ahead is 14.54 €/m² (+4.5%), with an 80% range of 14.03 to 14.93 €/m²; housing-loan rates are at 4.01%.
